description: bin/spawn-funding-swap.mjs:38 (`const STATE_DIR = process.env.SPAWN_FUNDING_SWAP_STATE_DIR;`) has NO default value, unlike its sibling config values on the two adjacent lines: THRESHOLD_AKT (line 36: `Number(process.env.SPAWN_FUNDING_SWAP_THRESHOLD_AKT || "26")`) and LEG_TIMEOUT_MS (line 37: `Number(process.env.SPAWN_FUNDING_SWAP_LEG_TIMEOUT_MS || "600000")`). In buildDeps()'s real (non-FAKE_DEPS_MODULE) production-wiring branch, line 68 calls `createLedgerStore({ stateDir: STATE_DIR })`; lib/ledger-store.mjs:37 immediately does `path.join(stateDir, "ledger-state.json")`. When STATE_DIR is undefined (the case for every real invocation today, since neither akt-treasury.sh's documented exported vars — AKASH_KEY_NAME/AKASH_KEYRING_BACKEND/AKASH_NODE/AKASH_CHAIN_ID, per behavioral-spec.md REQ-008's edge case — nor any other part of this feature's own config sets SPAWN_FUNDING_SWAP_STATE_DIR), `path.join(undefined, ...)` throws a synchronous `TypeError [ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE]` the instant buildDeps() runs with a successfully-resolved identity. This means the production entrypoint TREASURY_SWAP_CMD is designed to be pointed at is not actually self-contained, directly violating REQ-008's own edge case ('the command MUST NOT depend on shell state ... beyond what akt-treasury.sh itself exports ... plus its own self-contained config'). The crash IS caught by main().catch() at the bottom of the file and exits non-zero before any lock/price/route/sign call — so it fails closed on money-safety grounds specifically — but it is an unconditional crash-via-uncaught-exception rather than a clean, intentional 'no STATE_DIR configured' error, and it is completely untested: every test in lib/__tests__/cli.test.mjs that reaches the real (non-fake) production wiring branch (the 'ANICCA_HOME unset' and 'ambient ANICCA_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY leak' tests) hits the identity gate and returns BEFORE createLedgerStore is ever called (bin/spawn-funding-swap.mjs:49-52 precedes line 68), and every test that reaches createLedgerStore uses SPAWN_FUNDING_SWAP_FAKE_DEPS_MODULE, which short-circuits buildDeps() at line 42-45 before line 68 is ever reached at all. There is therefore zero test coverage anywhere in this 98-test suite for 'identity resolves successfully AND real ledgerStore construction is attempted' — the exact shape the real akt-treasury.sh invocation (once wired, per the contract's own 'Known residual scope boundary' section) will have.
